title: A House, a Room, and the Stem That Bends
label: ch:mr-the-oblique-stem
canDo: I can name a house and a room, and I can put either of them into the -t locative, knowing which one changes shape first and why.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R41-in-the-house and answer kuṭhe? twice with a place you can name -- gharāt and khoolīt -- saying which of the two nouns had to bend.
payoff.note: The two nouns come first and the rule second on purpose: the oblique stem is only visible on a noun the reader already owns.
